name: ResellerRatings

sources.title: Homepage — 'Store Ratings & Reviews', long-running merchant review platform
Docs — claim existing store page or create a profile via /merchantsignup; free-mail addresses not accepted for merchant signup
Docs — new stores are added by customers or via merchant sales team; all submissions reviewed

requirements: You need a real business with customers who can review it — it's a merchant review platform, not a launch board
Merchant signup at /merchantsignup does NOT accept Gmail/free-mail accounts — use a work domain email (or contact support@resellerratings.com)
Two routes: claim an existing store page (search the site → 'Claim Your Business Profile' → verification) or submit business info at /merchantsignup for review
All store submissions are reviewed and approved by their team
Only customers can submit a new store directly on-site; merchants without an existing page go through merchant signup/sales
preparation: Work-domain email (not Gmail/Hotmail) for the merchant account
Business details: name, URL, address, hours, contact info — 'the more information you add, the more credible you appear'
Logo to replace the auto-generated thumbnail on the store page
A plan to drive real customer reviews (they do not add stores proactively — customer evaluations create listings)
workflow: Search resellerratings.com for your store to see if a page already exists
If yes: click 'Claim Your Business Profile' and complete verification
If no: submit business info at https://www.resellerratings.com/merchantsignup (or ask customers to submit the store)
Wait for approval, then complete the store profile (logo, details)
Invite customers to leave reviews — the store page ranks in search once reviews accumulate
watchFor: Free-mail rejection at merchant signup is the biggest self-serve blocker
Never fake reviews — users are '100% legally liable' for their evaluations and the platform is strict
They will NOT remove a company page once listed ('we do not remove companies from the site')
Free tier exists for new/small businesses but scope is limited; fuller merchant tools are paid (contact sales)
Merchant rebuttals/flagging require a merchant member account
countsAsLive: A public /store/<your-domain> page exists showing your company with a star rating once the first verified customer review is posted
unknowns: Approval turnaround for new merchant submissions
Exact free-tier limits vs paid merchant plans
